name: termalin
description: SSH, SFTP, databases, monitoring and backups for your own servers from ChatGPT, keyless through the Termalin Connector, with skills for checking server health, triaging alerts, running commands safely, verifying deployments and querying databases.

interface.shortDescription: SSH and your servers from ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Let ChatGPT work on your own Linux and Windows servers through Termalin: run commands, read and edit files, query databases, check monitoring and alerts, run long jobs and take encrypted backups. Servers are reached keylessly through a small Connector, so no SSH key or password is shared and no inbound port is opened, and every command is logged. The skills teach ChatGPT to look at monitoring before running anything, to triage an alert step by step, to verify a deployment, to query databases safely and to stop before risky changes.
defaultPrompt: Why is my site slow? Check the server and the logs.
I just deployed. Check that everything on the server is fine.
